column1: # Your own phrases. Type the code in Roman letters and the text is the first candidate.
# One phrase per line: the code, a TAB, then the text.
# - A code is Roman letters only (a-z, A-Z), matched exactly as typed.
# - In the text, \n is a line break, \t a tab and \\ a backslash.
# - Several lines with one code give several candidates, in the order you list them.
# - Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# - Phrases are never learned, so private text stays in this file only.
# - Saving the file is enough; the Server reads it again within a few seconds.
